besluite.rede: 'Party van die goud' is standard Afrikaans for a portion of a mass noun, so the swap to 'n deel' is lateral.
'Koop van die suiwer goud' is a natural partitive linking back to the refined gold of the previous block; dropping 'van die' loses that link and the 'some of it' sense.
In context 'die mynmaatskappye' reads naturally as the companies owning the mines just discussed, so removing the article is a lateral move that also loosens the reference.
The definition is grammatical and readable, and 'klip waarin goud sit' deliberately matches the wording of the rif definition and the study text, so rewording it would break that parallel.
